name: The Wanderers
source:
Enter Project Wanderer, a Visual Novel project centering around the tale of an unlucky human and friends traveling together in the world of Eden, to discover friendship, hardship, and secrets. It also a tale of the three gods, or Magistrates, of Eden and how they end up manipulating the world to their benefits, and they chose select mortals to join into their game. However, fate has another plan in store and sent forth a human to Eden, hoping to be free of the gods' tyranny.

[From [url=https://hyperionthunder.itch.io/the-wanderers] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《流浪者计划》是一个视觉小说项目，讲述了一个不幸的人类和朋友们一起在伊甸园世界中旅行，发现友谊、困难和秘密的故事。这也是伊甸园三位神或行政长官的故事，以及他们最终如何操纵世界以谋取利益，并选择选定的凡人加入他们的游戏。然而，命运另有安排，将人类送到伊甸园，希望摆脱众神的暴政。

[来自[url=https://hyperionthunder.itch.io/the-wanderers] itch.io[/url]]
